g.text: nogForge is KognogOS's package app: your installed programs,
searching and installing new ones, and updates, in plain words. It
, KognogOS's package manager, and shows what nog
decides: which tier a package is in, when an update is ready, and
what must stay together. nogForge never decides those itself.
It has the Dashboard, In-System, Install, Update (with your
choices), Maintenance and History, for every source: the
repositories, the AUR, Flatpak and Snap. Settings come next.
: updates waiting, your packages, what nog did lately,
: nog's update plan: untick what waits, promote what
: what each source has left behind; tick what goes,
: opens its menu: this manual, the list of keys, the
